name: Software package ecosystem activity
product_relevance_reason: Package adoption bears on developer-ecosystem activity and competitive supply, as a proxy. It is not revenue and not customers.
exact_world_state_unit: a package download event, or a package release event

routes.note: The registry's own download logs are the origin.
source_says: This table is populated through the Linehaul project by streaming download logs from PyPI to BigQuery.

routes.note: Analytics products for PyPI downloads read the published BigQuery table rather than observing a download. A second reader of one counter is a second copy, not a second witness.

same_proposition_reason: A download event exists only because the registry's edge logged it. Nobody else is positioned to observe it, so the quantity is SOURCE_EXCLUSIVE_METRIC and every other publisher is a distribution layer. This is the Mission 1.46 and 1.57 law, confirmed here on the registry's own documentation.
mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1
